"""Compare complete barrier objectives at the archived start and terminal point."""
import argparse
from fractions import Fraction as F
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from smatrix_bootstrap.primal_barrier import PrimalLogBarrier


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('result',type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);args=p.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():raise FileExistsError('Comparison artifacts are immutable')
    raw=args.result.read_bytes();r=json.loads(raw);seed_bytes=Path(r['seed_path']).read_bytes();input_bytes=Path(r['input_path']).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(seed_bytes).hexdigest()!=r['seed_sha256'] or hashlib.sha256(input_bytes).hexdigest()!=r['input_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Input/seed hash mismatch')
    seed=json.loads(seed_bytes);payload=json.loads(input_bytes)
    model=PrimalLogBarrier.from_payload(payload,equality_rank=seed['equality_rank'],equality_rows=seed['equality_rows'],
        pivot_columns=seed['pivot_columns'],pivot_inverse=seed['pivot_inverse'])
    points=[list(map(F,r['initial_x_rational'])),list(map(F,r['result']['x_rational']))];evaluations=[]
    mu=F.from_float(r['result']['last_mu']);factor=F(2)**seed['objective_scale_power']
    for x in points:
        model.eq.validate_seed(x);ns,den=model.exact_slack(x);certificate=model.certify_strict_slack(ns,den)
        if not certificate['strict']:raise ValueError('Comparison point is not exactly strict')
        barrier=model.evaluate(ns,den,certificate,derivatives=False)[0]
        objective=sum((q*v for q,v in zip(model.c_frac,x)),F(0))
        evaluations.append(dict(exact_linear_objective=str(objective),barrier_F_float64=barrier,
            Phi_float64=float(objective)+float(mu)*barrier,f11=-float(objective/factor),exactly_strict=True))
    delta_q=F(evaluations[1]['exact_linear_objective'])-F(evaluations[0]['exact_linear_objective'])
    delta_F=evaluations[1]['barrier_F_float64']-evaluations[0]['barrier_F_float64']
    out=dict(result_path=str(args.result),result_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        mu_rational=str(mu),definition='Phi=q.x+mu*F(b-Ax), all original input cone barrier terms',
        start=evaluations[0],terminal=evaluations[1],exact_linear_objective_change=str(delta_q),
        barrier_F_change_float64=delta_F,Phi_change_float64=float(delta_q)+float(mu)*delta_F,
        independent_full_barrier_evaluation=True,optimizer_run_performed=False,full_Hessian_assembled=False,
        scope='Exact rational linear objective and feasibility; full barrier scalars evaluated by the frozen Float64 barrier routine, so Phi comparison is numerical, not an interval certificate',
        source_snapshot_utf8={str(Path(__file__)):Path(__file__).read_text()})
    out['source_sha256']={k:hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest() for k,v in out['source_snapshot_utf8'].items()}
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
